name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A overlay for AI agent deployments. Maps AKSI controls to ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls across the four themes: Organizational (A.5), People (A.6), Physical (A.7), and Technological (A.8). This overlay covers the ISMS controls most relevant to AI agent security and governance.

reporting_obligations.assessment_type: Third-party certification audit (Stage 1: documentation review, Stage 2: implementation audit) plus annual surveillance audits and 3-year recertification cycle. Auditors will expect evidence for all applicable Annex A controls. This overlay maps AKSI controls to the Annex A controls most relevant to AI agent deployments.
reporting_obligations.reporting_entity: Organization holding or pursuing ISO 27001 certification (the 'organization' in ISMS scope)

human_oversight_mandates.basis: A.5.35 (independent review of information security), A.5.36 (compliance with policies), A.8.16 (monitoring activities)
human_oversight_mandates.minimum_requirement: Human review of AI agent risk assessments and compliance monitoring outputs; documented management review of ISMS effectiveness including AI agent security controls

notes: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 supersedes ISO/IEC 27001:2013. The 2022 revision reorganized Annex A from 114 controls in 14 domains to 93 controls in 4 themes (Organizational A.5, People A.6, Physical A.7, Technological A.8). New controls relevant to AI agents include A.5.7 (Threat intelligence), A.5.23 (Information security for use of cloud services), A.8.9 (Configuration management), A.8.10 (Information deletion), A.8.11 (Data masking), A.8.16 (Monitoring activities), A.8.23 (Web filtering), A.8.28 (Secure coding). AI agents should be treated as information assets within the ISMS scope, with their tools and MCP servers treated as cloud services or suppliers under A.5.23 and A.5.19. This overlay does not cover the full ISMS (clauses 4-10) which are organizational requirements — it covers only the Annex A technical controls most directly mappable to AKSI.
